_about: Chain defaults, calibrated on a pop test song (source -14.7 LUFS / -3.35 dBTP). Thresholds are absolute dBFS AFTER the input is normalized to input_norm_lufs, so they carry over to other songs. The tonal EQ starts empty: every move is decided per song from the first listen (ears.py) and plan.py, which also switches stages off when the song does not need them (references/chain.md sections 3 and 8). Song A's EQ is kept in chain.md as an example.
